title: intake.detect rows carry the detector's run time
goal: bl_intake.collect(record=True) times each detector run and the intake.detect row it writes holds an integer ms; OPS_EVENTS['intake.detect'] takes an optional ms, and querylog.md and tools.md say so; a detector run that finds nothing writes no new row.

run: import os,sys,json,time,tempfile,shutil;from pathlib import Path;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA']=str(t/'d');os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT']=str(Path.cwd());sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_intake as i,ql_capture as q;i.DETECTORS['planted']=lambda root:(time.sleep(.05),[i.Candidate(kind='bug',title='t',goal='g',key='k')])[1];c,f=i.collect(str(t),only='planted',record=True);rows=[json.loads(l) for p in Path(q.spool_dir()).glob('*.jsonl') for l in p.read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()];shutil.rmtree(t);d=[r for r in rows if r.get('event')=='intake.detect'];print('candidates',len(c),'failures',f,'intake.detect rows:',[{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k in ('detector','found','ms')} for r in d]);sys.exit(0 if len(d)==1 and type(d[0].get('ms')) is int and d[0]['ms']>=40 else 1)

notes: Premise (2026-10-07): the check's planted detector sleeps 50 ms and its intake.detect row holds no ms.
